description: Gets the results of a report instance created by running a report. Poll `attributes.status` until it equals 'Success' before parsing results. Response data is nested under `factMap` and `reportExtendedMetadata`; an empty `factMap` or zero rows is a valid successful result, not an error.

instance_id.description: The report instance ID returned from running a report.
instance_id.human_parameter_description: The specific run of the report whose results you want to fetch. This ID is returned when you run the report and create an instance.
instance_id.title: Instance Id

report_id.description: The Salesforce ID of the report.
report_id.human_parameter_description: The ID of the report you ran and want results for. You can find this in the report’s URL in Salesforce when viewing the report.
report_id.title: Report Id
